descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在吉隆坡吃椰浆饭后做的纸菜单，蛋和黄瓜各有位置。
descriptions.en: My paper menu after nasi lemak in Kuala Lumpur gives the egg and cucumber their own spaces.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 这张自制纸菜单留着面饼蘸进咖喱的一小角。
descriptions.en: My homemade paper menu records the corner of bread that stayed in the curry.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 双子塔前那次捡帽子之后剪的纸签，帽檐可以往回折。
descriptions.en: My paper tab after retrieving the hat by the twin towers has a brim that folds back.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我给自己的脚尖折的小纸角，记着在公园看步道的停顿，不复制园路图。
descriptions.en: My folded toe corner remembers a pause over the park path, without reproducing its layout.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的纸塔小卡，桥两头各有一只短纸脚，是自己的简化造型。
descriptions.en: My simplified paper-tower card has a short folded foot beneath each end of its bridge.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在吉隆坡自制的折页，翻开时，两顶纸帽子都牢牢留在纸脑袋上。
descriptions.en: My homemade Kuala Lumpur foldout keeps both paper hats firmly on their paper heads.
